messages.content: Hey pt-1006, weekly check-in. What'd you get?

Nope, can't do that—insurance and copay stuff goes through your pharmacy or insurance company directly. If there's something medical you need to talk through, I can get a nurse on it though. Next week still good?
all good, don't need the nurse. yeah next week
